description: Reviewed readiness of every ECC MCP server for ECC's sets. Only a ready server, one that runs from the pick as installed with no unsupported or unverified provider, beta consent, preprovisioning or required setup value, may be a set member. Every other server stays an individual choice with its description unchanged. The Catalog has no structured field that tells the two apart, so this list is the reviewed record; tools/generate-ecc-release-17.mjs fails on any ECC MCP server it does not name.

ready.ecc.mcp.clickhouse: Documented hosted ClickHouse HTTP endpoint; the client performs OAuth, with no setup value.
ready.ecc.mcp.github: Official hosted GitHub read-only HTTP endpoint; the client performs OAuth, with no setup value.
ready.ecc.mcp.laraplugins: Documented anonymous Laraplugins HTTP endpoint with no key or account prerequisite.
ready.ecc.mcp.parallel-search: Documented anonymous limited-access Parallel HTTP endpoint with no setup value.
ready.ecc.mcp.railway-hosted: Official Railway hosted HTTP endpoint; the client performs OAuth, with no setup value.
ready.ecc.mcp.vercel: Documented Vercel HTTP endpoint; the client performs OAuth, with no setup value.

notReady.ecc.mcp.browser-use: Requires the BROWSER_USE_KEY secret, which has no default.
notReady.ecc.mcp.browserbase: Separately acquired npm package: the caller must supply the npmCli and npmCache paths and the AIHQ_MCP_*_ROOT runtime directory before it can run.
notReady.ecc.mcp.cloudflare-docs: Requires network reachability and endpoint-specific account/OAuth authorization; upstream gives no complete credential contract.
notReady.ecc.mcp.cloudflare-observability: Requires network reachability and endpoint-specific account/OAuth authorization; upstream gives no complete credential contract.

notReady.ecc.mcp.cloudflare-workers-builds: Requires network reachability and endpoint-specific account/OAuth authorization; upstream gives no complete credential contract.
notReady.ecc.mcp.codescene: Separately acquired npm package: the caller must supply the npmCli and npmCache paths and the AIHQ_MCP_*_ROOT runtime directory before it can run. The native codescene binary must also be preprovisioned, and CS_ACCESS_TOKEN and CS_MCP_BINARY_PATH supplied.
